title: Focus areas: Manage strategic goals with the new REST API
description:
Atlassian has released a new REST API for focus areas, allowing you to programmatically manage and integrate your strategic goals with other apps. This update enables teams to automate the creation and management of focus areas, ensuring that strategic priorities remain synchronized across your entire workflow. Go to the Atlassian developer portal to access the focus areas API documentation.
	Generate an API token from your Atlassian account settings to authenticate your requests.
